Should not we return here instead, after having closed the cipher?

You are right, the padding validation was not there initially and it only prints debug info.
But it makes no sense to continue padding verification, if decryption fails, and it hides the correct error return value. I'll post a new MR in a few minutes, which fixes this issue.
